newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar closes lower on overseas trend.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar closes lower on overseas trend.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar closed lower against the U.S. dollar on Monday as it tracked the greenback's strength overseas, but dealers saw little room for the local currency to fall further.
The local unit ended at T$27.670, against Saturday's T$27.648 close.
Turnover through dealers was an active US$262 million.
"Despite the U.S. dollar's strength overseas, exporters are buying the Taiwan dollar as soon as it approaches the T$26.68 level," said one dealer at a foreign bank.
A T$27.64-68 range was seen for Tuesday. -- K. Chen(5080815)
